inheritance: All JPN36 fail-closed field-pilot gates, state-aware module-function priorities, Japan38 repeated-history results, JPN34 orientation repair, Japan7 colour stop rule and absolute-time constraints remain in force unless explicitly updated below.

azami_capitulum_v3_scoring.decision: The statistics layer is no longer the blocker. The current v2 simulator cannot be scored against the 62 new targets because it does not emit the exact observation-level 18-endpoint plus nine-environment schema.

frozen_environment_design_available.use_rule: The next v3 generator should condition synthetic phenotype rows on the frozen environmental design. Exact coordinates need not enter the public downstream model table; taxon membership and the nine predictor values are sufficient for the 62 estimands.
frozen_environment_design_available.target_leakage_rule: Do not use observed 18D phenotype values or the 62 target values to tune endpoint loadings or mechanism priors before model-family outcomes are inspected. The fixed environmental design is treated as exogenous conditioning information.

next_generator_gate.required_output: observation-level synthetic table with taxon_name, 18 frozen response endpoints and nine frozen environmental predictors
predeclare_before_scoring: which model families permit process-environment effects beyond core4
within-taxon versus among-taxon effect coupling rules
all parameter priors and random seeds
prohibited: fit endpoint loadings to the observed module-contrast targets
fit process coefficients to the observed block-R2 or partial-R2 targets before the one-shot comparison
map legacy scalar v2 outputs into the 62-target distance by semantic analogy

parallel_field_state.action_while_field_blocked: Advance the simulation interface and model-discrimination layer without pretending that field data already exist.

claim_boundary: Readiness for a matched model-output interface only. A future low-distance v3 result would establish model reproduction of selected observational structure, not causal mechanism, adaptation, selection, plasticity, defence or genetic/developmental modularity.
